Don't try to 'age with grace,' age with mischief, audacity, and a good story to tell." Below the main text, there is a signature or a name that appears to be "Basta." At the bottom of the image, there is a social media handle "@mommydrinkswineandswears," suggesting that the note was shared on a platform like Instagram.
